## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Scope

List affected files or services and explain how the change fits the current
project stage and subject requirements.

## Validation

Describe the checks actually performed and their results. State clearly when
runtime checks do not apply or have not been run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated existing content.
- [ ] Affected documentation matches the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, runtime data, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Applicable subject requirements and third-party notices are respected.
- [ ] Any relevant limitations or follow-up work are described.
